title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
一时间，陈青云看呆了，根本挪不开眼，只觉得口干舌燥，热血沸腾。“快出去，不许看！”宁轻眉反应过来，娇叱一声，但声音中除了生气，更多的却是娇羞。自己最大的秘密，竟然被别人发现了。“对不起！”陈青云连忙退了出去，但脑海中却满是刚才那一抹雪白，忍不住浮想联翩。……几分钟后，厕所内，又传来宁轻眉虚弱的喊声：“青云，我好了，但没力气穿裤子，你能进来帮我一下么？”“好。”陈青云求之不得，立刻冲了进去，大饱眼福的同时，又替她穿戴完毕。整个过程中，宁轻眉一直红着脸不吭声，任由他在自己身上动作，但她心脏砰砰直跳，甚至还有一丝难以言喻的刺激。很快，陈青云抱着她回去。病房内静悄悄的，但两人之间，却滋生了暧昧的气氛。“青云，刚才的事情，就当没发生过吧……”宁轻眉扭过头，羞的不敢看他。“好，不过轻眉姐，按照我们老家的说法，白虎克夫，吸人元气！”陈青云一本正经说道。“你……”宁轻眉没想到他会提起这个，俏脸涨得通红。她也知道自己身体的特殊，以及那些不好的传闻。在结婚后，她丈夫也的确疾病缠身，甚至不能人道，害得她守了好几年活寡。“但我爷爷有个偏方，可以改善这种体质，你要不要试试？”陈青云又说道。“真的，要怎么做？！”宁轻眉眼睛一亮，露出欣喜之色。“可以用特制的药油，配合独门‘抓凤筋’手法，按摩你那个地方，几个疗程后就能有好转了！”陈青云解释起来。听到这话，宁轻眉咬紧水润的红唇，默不作声。抓凤筋？这听起来，怎么有点不正经。

陈青云给自己按摩那儿，这未免太羞耻了……“砰！”就在这时，病房的大门被推开，一个年轻女子闯了进来。她大概二十五六岁，打扮时髦，穿着玫红色长裙，拎着香奈儿包包，脖戴四叶草项链，手上是卡地亚手镯，光是这行头就要大几十万，绝对是个顶级白富美。她的容貌也是顶级的，瓜子脸，桃花眼，肤白貌美，媚态横生。“轻眉，你没事吧？”她立刻冲到病床边，一脸紧张。“云妃，多亏了这位小伙子，我才化险为夷！”宁轻眉指了指一旁的陈青云。萧云妃望了过去，也是眼睛一亮，没想到在这小县城，还有如此高大帅气的男子！“帅哥，我叫萧云妃，多谢你救了我闺蜜！”她主动伸出玉手。陈青云与她握了一下，只觉得柔若无骨，心中一荡。两女是不同的风格，如果说宁轻眉是高岭之花，那她就是热辣玫瑰，性感十足。冰火两重天！若是能左拥右抱，和她们同时快活一次，那滋味不知能有多美。当然，陈青云也只是心里幻想一下。像这样的白富美，自己一年工资都买不起她一件首饰，完全是两个世界的人。三人又聊了一会儿，宁轻眉将陈青云挺身相救的事情，说给闺蜜听。当然，用嘴吸蛇毒和刚才厕所脱裤子，她就省略了。饶是如此，萧云妃还是拉着陈青云的手，千恩万谢，身上淡淡的幽香时不时飘来，令人沉醉。“轻眉姐，既然你朋友来了，那我就先回去了！”陈青云起身，离开了病房。“等等！”萧云妃追了过来，在红裙的映衬之下，她那张妩媚的瓜子脸，美的惊心动魄。“你刚才说自己原本是县长秘书，却被小人落井下石，发配到了水库？”萧云妃问道。“嗯。”陈青云点头。“塞翁失马，焉知非福！我倒是觉得，你快要交大运了！”萧云妃神秘一笑。陈青云挑了挑眉，反问道：“萧小姐，难道你会算命？”

For a moment, Chen Qingyun was stunned and couldn't move his eyes away at all. He only felt that his mouth was dry and his blood was boiling."Get out quickly, don't look!" Ning Qingmei reacted and scolded, but in addition to being angry, her voice was more shy.His biggest secret was discovered by others."I'm sorry!" Chen Qingyun quickly retreated, but his mind was filled with the flash of white just now, and he couldn't help but think about it....A few minutes later, Ning Qingmei's weak cry came from the toilet: "Qingyun, I'm fine, but I don't have the strength to put on my pants. Can you come in and help me?" "Okay." Chen Qingyun couldn't help but rushed in immediately, feasting his eyes on it, and finished dressing it for her.During the whole process, Ning Qingmei remained blushing and silent, letting him move on her body, but her heart was beating fast, and there was even a hint of indescribable excitement.Soon, Chen Qingyun carried her back.The ward was quiet, but an ambiguous atmosphere arose between the two of them."Qingyun, just pretend that what just happened never happened..." Ning Qingqing turned her head, too shy to look at him."Okay, but Sister Qingmei, according to the saying in our hometown, White Tiger Kefu absorbs people's vitality!" Chen Qingyun said seriously."You..." Ning Qingmei didn't expect him to mention this, and her pretty face turned red.She also knows about the specialness of her body and the bad rumors about it.After getting married, her husband was indeed ill and even inhumane, causing her to remain a widow for several years."But my grandfather has a folk remedy that can improve this physical condition. Do you want to try it?" Chen Qingyun said again."Really, what should we do?!" Ning Qingmei's eyes lit up with joy."You can use special medicated oil, combined with the unique 'Fengjin Grasping' technique, to massage your area, and you will see improvement after a few courses of treatment!" Chen Qingyun explained.Hearing this, Ning Qingmei bit her moist red lips and remained silent.Grab the phoenix tendon?This sounds a bit unfair.

It was too shameful for Chen Qingyun to massage herself... "Bang!" At this moment, the door of the ward was pushed open, and a young woman broke in.She is about 25 or 26 years old, dressed fashionably, wearing a rose red dress, carrying a Chanel bag, a four-leaf clover necklace around her neck, and a Cartier bracelet on her hand. This outfit alone costs hundreds of thousands, and she is definitely a top-notch white and rich beauty.Her appearance is also top-notch, with an oval face, peach blossom eyes, fair skin, beautiful appearance, and charming charm."Qingmei, are you okay?" She immediately rushed to the bedside with a nervous look on her face."Fei Yun, thanks to this young man, I saved the day!" Ning Qingmei pointed at Chen Qingyun beside her.Concubine Xiao Yun looked over and her eyes lit up. She didn't expect that there was such a tall and handsome man in this small county!"Handsome guy, my name is Xiao Yunfei, thank you for saving my bestie!" She took the initiative to extend her jade hand.Chen Qingyun shook her hand and felt as if she was as soft as a bone, and her heart swayed.The two women have different styles. If Ning Qingmei is the flower of the high mountains, then she is the hot rose, full of sexiness.The two heavens of ice and fire!If I could hug each other and have fun with them at the same time, I don't know how beautiful it would be.Of course, Chen Qingyun was just fantasizing in his heart.A Bai Fumei like this can't even afford a piece of jewelry with her annual salary, so she is completely from two different worlds.The three of them chatted for a while, and Ning Qingmei told her best friend about Chen Qingyun's rescue.Of course, she omitted the use of mouth to suck snake venom and the moment she took off her pants in the toilet.Even so, Concubine Xiao Yun still held Chen Qingyun's hand and thanked her profusely. The faint fragrance from her body floated from time to time, which was intoxicating."Sister Qingmei, since your friend is here, I will go back first!" Chen Qingyun stood up and left the ward."Wait!" Concubine Xiao Yun chased after her. Against the backdrop of the red dress, her charming oval face was so beautiful that it was breathtaking."You just said that you were originally the secretary of the county magistrate, but you were tricked by a villain and sent to the reservoir?" Concubine Xiao Yun asked."Yeah." Chen Qingyun nodded."A blessing in disguise, a blessing in disguise! I think you are about to have great luck!" Concubine Xiao Yun smiled mysteriously.Chen Qingyun raised his eyebrows and asked: "Miss Xiao, can you tell fortunes?"
